## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature clearly. Include any API changes, schema changes, or configuration additions.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider and why did you reject them?

## Additional Context

Diagrams, mockups, references to related issues or PRs.
